# Garmin

Every app in this list that runs on Garmin. That is 2 apps with 1 for Plex and 1 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Music

- [OpenPlayer (web-gears)](https://github.com/web-gears/openplayer) - Garmin watch player for music and podcasts synced from a media server. `Jellyfin` · `Garmin` · `Open source` `Free`
- [SubMusic](https://github.com/memen45/SubMusic) - Garmin watch app that syncs music for offline listening. `Plex` `+Subsonic` · `Garmin` · `GPL-3.0` `Stale 2024`
